snippet.title: Fractured in Alterac Valley Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
The conflict between the Frostwolf Clan and Stormpike Guard rages deep in the heart of the Alterac Mountains. Both the Horde and the Alliance are driven by honor to capture and claim this renowned valley as their own. Dispatching the Ice Lord seems like a good place to start...

Fractured in Alterac Valley will launch worldwide on December 7 with 135 new collectible cards, the new Honorable Kill keyword, Objective Spells, and Hero Cards for each Mercenary class character!

• Learn more about Fractured in Alterac Valley: https://playhearthstone.com/news/23746635 
• Read the 21.8 Patch Notes: https://playhearthstone.com/news/23746636
